title_en: Child custody and parenting plans in {state}
title_es: Custodia de los hijos y planes de crianza en {state_es}

facts.claim_en: Unmarried Alaska parents file a custody case to set a parenting plan covering legal custody, physical custody and child support.
facts.claim_es: Los padres no casados en Alaska presentan un caso de custodia para fijar un plan de crianza con custodia legal, custodia física y manutención.
facts.source_name: Alaska Court System Self-Help: Custody
facts.quote: A custody case is filed by unmarried parents to figure out a parenting plan that includes legal custody , physical custody and child support .

facts.claim_en: A custody and visitation or parenting plan must describe the legal and physical custody that serves the children's interests.
facts.claim_es: Un plan de custodia y visitas o de crianza debe describir la custodia legal y física que sea en el mejor interés de los hijos.
facts.source_name: Alaska Court System Self-Help: Family Law Glossary
facts.quote: The custody and visitation or parenting plan must describe the legal custody and physical custody that is in the child(ren)'s best interests .

facts.claim_en: A custody investigator assesses the family and recommends a parenting plan to the judge.
facts.claim_es: Un investigador de custodia evalúa a la familia y recomienda un plan de crianza al juez.
facts.source_name: Alaska Court System Self-Help: Family Law Glossary
facts.quote: The custody investigator assesses a family and recommends to the judge a parenting plan that is in the best interests of the children .

official_links.label_en: Alaska Court System Self-Help: Custody
official_links.label_es: Alaska Court System Self-Help: Custody

official_links.label_en: Alaska Court System Self-Help: Family Law Glossary
official_links.label_es: Alaska Court System Self-Help: Family Law Glossary

facts.claim_en: Arizona requires a written parenting plan whenever parents ask the court to order joint custody.
facts.claim_es: Arizona exige un plan de crianza por escrito cuando los padres piden al tribunal la custodia compartida.
facts.source_name: Arizona Judicial Branch: Glossary
facts.quote: A written parenting plan is required whenever parents ask the court to order joint custody.

facts.claim_en: A parent living outside Arizona may meet the parent education class requirement with a comparable class where they live.
facts.claim_es: Un padre que vive fuera de Arizona puede cumplir el requisito de la clase de educación para padres con una clase similar donde vive.
facts.source_name: Arizona Judicial Branch: Parent Education Program
facts.quote: they may be able to satisfy the requirements of the parent education class by attending a comparable class in the area where the other parent lives

facts.claim_en: For a case involving a minor child, the child must have lived in Arizona for at least 6 months before filing.
facts.claim_es: En un caso con un hijo menor, el niño debe haber vivido en Arizona al menos 6 meses antes de presentar.
facts.source_name: Arizona Judicial Branch: Family Law
facts.quote: If the action involves a minor child, that child must have lived in Arizona for at least 6 months prior to filing.

official_links.label_es: Arizona Judicial Branch: Glossary

facts.claim_en: When you separate from your child's other parent in California, you need a parenting plan.
facts.claim_es: Cuando se separa del otro padre de su hijo en California, necesita un plan de crianza.
facts.source_name: California Courts Self-Help Guide: Child Custody
facts.quote: When you separate from your child’s other parent, you need a parenting plan.

facts.claim_en: Parenting plans must serve the children's interests.
facts.claim_es: Los planes de crianza deben ser en el mejor interés de los hijos.
facts.source_name: California Courts Self-Help Guide: Child Custody
facts.quote: Parenting plans must be in the best interest of your children.

facts.claim_en: Parents with joint custody can set specific rules about certain decisions.
facts.claim_es: Los padres con custodia compartida pueden fijar reglas específicas sobre ciertas decisiones.
facts.source_name: California Courts Self-Help Guide: Enforce a Custody Order
facts.quote: For parents with joint custody, this lets you make specific rules about certain decisions.

official_links.label_en: California Courts Self-Help Guide: Child Custody
official_links.label_es: California Courts Self-Help Guide: Child Custody

official_links.label_en: California Courts Self-Help Guide: Enforce a Custody Order
official_links.label_es: California Courts Self-Help Guide: Enforce a Custody Order

facts.claim_en: In DC custody cases between parents, the child's interest is the primary consideration under the law's 'best interest' standard.
facts.claim_es: En los casos de custodia entre padres en DC, el interés del hijo es la consideración principal según la norma legal.
facts.source_name: Code of the District of Columbia § 16-914
facts.quote: In any proceeding between parents in which the custody of a child is raised as an issue, the best interest of the child shall be the primary consideration.

facts.claim_en: The DC court considers all relevant factors when deciding custody.
facts.claim_es: El tribunal de DC considera todos los factores pertinentes al decidir la custodia.
facts.source_name: Code of the District of Columbia § 16-914
facts.quote: the court shall consider all relevant factors, including, but not limited to:

facts.claim_en: The same standard applies when the court decides a child's care and custody.
facts.claim_es: La misma norma se aplica cuando el tribunal decide el cuidado y la custodia de un hijo.
facts.source_name: Code of the District of Columbia § 16-914
facts.quote: In determining the care and custody of a child, the best interest of the child shall be the primary consideration.

official_links.label_en: Code of the District of Columbia § 16-914
official_links.label_es: Code of the District of Columbia § 16-914

facts.claim_en: In Georgia, when one parent gets both physical and legal custody, it is called sole custody.
facts.claim_es: En Georgia, cuando un padre recibe la custodia física y la legal, se llama custodia exclusiva.
facts.source_name: Georgia Courts Access to Justice: Child Custody
facts.quote: When one parent is awarded both physical and legal custody, this is called sole custody.

facts.claim_en: The parent who does not get physical custody is usually awarded visitation.
facts.claim_es: El padre que no recibe la custodia física generalmente recibe derecho de visitas.
facts.source_name: Georgia Courts Access to Justice: Child Custody
facts.quote: The parent who does not get physical custody is usually awarded visitation.

facts.claim_en: If the parents are married, they have equal rights to visitation and custody.
facts.claim_es: Si los padres están casados, tienen los mismos derechos de visitas y custodia.
facts.source_name: Georgia Courts Access to Justice: Child Custody
facts.quote: If the parents are married, they have equal rights to visitation and custody.

official_links.label_en: Georgia Courts Access to Justice: Child Custody
official_links.label_es: Georgia Courts Access to Justice: Child Custody

facts.claim_en: In Iowa, joint custody does not necessarily mean the child spends equal time with both parents.
facts.claim_es: En Iowa, la custodia compartida no significa necesariamente que el hijo pase el mismo tiempo con ambos padres.
facts.source_name: Iowa Judicial Branch: Child Custody
facts.quote: Joint custody does not necessarily mean that the child must spend equal time with or live with both parents.

facts.claim_en: Sole legal custody means only one parent has legal responsibility for the child.
facts.claim_es: La custodia legal exclusiva significa que solo un padre tiene la responsabilidad legal del hijo.
facts.source_name: Iowa Judicial Branch: Child Custody
facts.quote: Sole legal custody means that only one parent has the legal responsibility of a minor child.

facts.claim_en: Sole legal custody is granted if the court decides it is better for one parent to make the decisions.
facts.claim_es: La custodia legal exclusiva se concede si el tribunal decide que es mejor que un solo padre tome las decisiones.
facts.source_name: Iowa Judicial Branch: Child Custody
facts.quote: Sole legal custody is granted if a court determines that it would be better for just one parent to make the decisions for the child.

official_links.label_en: Iowa Judicial Branch: Child Custody
official_links.label_es: Iowa Judicial Branch: Child Custody

facts.claim_en: Maryland requires a parenting plan in any case asking the court for custody or to change custody.
facts.claim_es: Maryland exige un plan de crianza en todo caso en que se pida la custodia o cambiarla.
facts.source_name: Maryland Judiciary: Parenting Plans
facts.quote: A parenting plan is required in any case a party asks the court for custody or to modify custody of a child.

facts.claim_en: A parenting plan is a written document that outlines how the parties will raise a child.
facts.claim_es: Un plan de crianza es un documento escrito que describe cómo las partes criarán al hijo.
facts.source_name: Maryland Judiciary: Parenting Plans
facts.quote: A parenting plan is a written document that outlines how parties will raise a child.

facts.claim_en: A parenting plan is not required in Child in Need of Assistance (CINA) cases.
facts.claim_es: No se requiere un plan de crianza en los casos de Menores que Necesitan Asistencia (CINA).
facts.source_name: Maryland Judiciary: Parenting Plans
facts.quote: A parenting plan is not required in Child in Need of Assistance (CINA) cases.

official_links.label_en: Maryland Judiciary: Parenting Plans
official_links.label_es: Maryland Judiciary: Parenting Plans

facts.claim_en: Your child must have lived in Massachusetts for at least 6 months right before you file for custody.
facts.claim_es: Su hijo debe haber vivido en Massachusetts al menos 6 meses justo antes de pedir la custodia.
facts.source_name: Mass.gov: Filing for child custody or parenting time
facts.quote: Your child must have lived in Massachusetts for at least 6 months immediately before you file for custody.

facts.claim_en: Parents who don't agree on custody or parenting time must take the four-hour online course 'Two Families Now' unless a judge waives it.
facts.claim_es: Los padres que no están de acuerdo en la custodia o el tiempo de crianza deben tomar el curso en línea de cuatro horas 'Two Families Now', salvo que un juez lo exima.
facts.source_name: Mass.gov: Filing for child custody or parenting time
facts.quote: must attend the four-hour online co-parenting course “Two Families Now” unless a Judge waives the requirement.

facts.claim_en: To change an order, one reason you can give is that the current arrangement isn't serving the children's interests.
facts.claim_es: Para cambiar una orden, una razón que puede dar es que el arreglo actual no cumple con el mejor interés de los hijos.
facts.source_name: Mass.gov: Request to change a custody or parenting time order
facts.quote: That the best interests of the children aren’t being met by the current arrangement

official_links.label_en: Mass.gov: Filing for child custody or parenting time
official_links.label_es: Mass.gov: Filing for child custody or parenting time

official_links.label_en: Mass.gov: Request to change a custody or parenting time order
official_links.label_es: Mass.gov: Request to change a custody or parenting time order

facts.claim_en: Nebraska spouses must develop a written parenting plan covering legal custody, physical custody and parenting time.
facts.claim_es: En Nebraska, los cónyuges deben preparar un plan de crianza por escrito que cubra la custodia legal, la custodia física y el tiempo de crianza.
facts.source_name: Nebraska Judicial Branch Self-Help: Divorce with Children
facts.quote: You and your spouse must develop a written parenting plan that addresses legal custody, physical custody, and parenting time.

facts.claim_en: Legal and physical custody can be awarded jointly or to one parent.
facts.claim_es: La custodia legal y la física se pueden otorgar en forma conjunta o a uno de los padres.
facts.source_name: Nebraska Judicial Branch Self-Help: Divorce with Children
facts.quote: There are two types of custody defined by statute – legal and physical – which can be awarded jointly to the parties or solely to one or the other.

facts.claim_en: Joint physical custody may affect the amount of child support.
facts.claim_es: La custodia física compartida puede afectar el monto de la manutención.
facts.source_name: Nebraska Judicial Branch Self-Help: Divorce with Children
facts.quote: The amount of child support may be affected by an award of joint physical custody.

facts.claim_en: Both spouses need to take a parenting education class.
facts.claim_es: Ambos cónyuges deben tomar una clase de educación para padres.
facts.source_name: Nebraska Judicial Branch Self-Help: Divorce with Children
facts.quote: Both you and your spouse need to take a parenting education class

official_links.label_en: Nebraska Judicial Branch Self-Help: Divorce with Children
official_links.label_es: Nebraska Judicial Branch Self-Help: Divorce with Children

facts.claim_en: In New Mexico, physical custody decides where the child lives and legal custody covers decision-making.
facts.claim_es: En Nuevo México, la custodia física decide dónde vive el hijo y la custodia legal cubre la toma de decisiones.
facts.source_name: New Mexico Courts Self-Representation
facts.quote: Physical custody decides where the child will live, and legal custody decides decision-making regarding the child.

facts.claim_en: A parenting plan is a court-approved document that sets each parent's responsibilities.
facts.claim_es: Un plan de crianza es un documento aprobado por el tribunal que fija las responsabilidades de cada padre.
facts.source_name: New Mexico Courts Self-Representation
facts.quote: A parenting plan is a court-approved document that sets each parent’s responsibilities.

facts.claim_en: If joint custody won't work or you need help with a schedule, you can ask the court for a referral to mediation.
facts.claim_es: Si la custodia compartida no funciona o necesita ayuda con un horario, puede pedir al tribunal que lo remita a mediación.
facts.source_name: New Mexico Courts Self-Representation
facts.quote: you should ask the court for a referral to mediation.

official_links.label_en: New Mexico Courts Self-Representation
official_links.label_es: New Mexico Courts Self-Representation

facts.claim_en: In North Carolina, legal custody is the right to make major decisions about the child.
facts.claim_es: En Carolina del Norte, la custodia legal es el derecho a tomar las decisiones importantes sobre el hijo.
facts.source_name: North Carolina Judicial Branch: Child Custody
facts.quote: Legal custody is the right to make major decisions about the child.

facts.claim_en: Physical custody is the right to have the child in your care all or part of the time.
facts.claim_es: La custodia física es el derecho a tener al hijo bajo su cuidado todo o parte del tiempo.
facts.source_name: North Carolina Judicial Branch: Child Custody
facts.quote: Physical custody means the right to have the child in your physical care, either all the time or part of the time.

facts.claim_en: Visitation is a secondary form of custody, with visits at times set in a court order.
facts.claim_es: Las visitas son una forma secundaria de custodia, con visitas en los horarios que fija una orden judicial.
facts.source_name: North Carolina Judicial Branch: Child Custody
facts.quote: Visitation is a secondary form of custody, which includes the right to visit with a child at times set forth in a court order

official_links.label_en: North Carolina Judicial Branch: Child Custody
official_links.label_es: North Carolina Judicial Branch: Child Custody

facts.claim_en: When both Ohio parents jointly file a shared-parenting plan, the court reviews whether it serves the children's interests.
facts.claim_es: Cuando ambos padres en Ohio presentan juntos un plan de crianza compartida, el tribunal revisa si es en el mejor interés de los hijos.
facts.source_name: Ohio Revised Code § 3109.04
facts.quote: the court shall review the parents' plan to determine if it is in the best interest of the c

facts.claim_en: If the court finds the plan serves the children's interests, it approves it.
facts.claim_es: Si el tribunal determina que el plan es en el mejor interés de los hijos, lo aprueba.
facts.source_name: Ohio Revised Code § 3109.04
facts.quote: If the court determines that the plan is in the best interest of the children, the court shall approve it.

facts.claim_en: The court may determine the child's wishes and concerns if that serves the child's interests.
facts.claim_es: El tribunal puede conocer los deseos e inquietudes del hijo si eso es en su mejor interés.
facts.source_name: Ohio Revised Code § 3109.04
facts.quote: If the court determines that it would be in the best interests of the child to determine the child's wishes and concerns with respect to the allocation, it shall proceed to make that determination.

official_links.label_en: Ohio Revised Code § 3109.04
official_links.label_es: Ohio Revised Code § 3109.04

facts.claim_en: In every Oregon county, parents must take classes as part of custody and parenting time cases.
facts.claim_es: En todos los condados de Oregón, los padres deben tomar clases como parte de los casos de custodia y tiempo de crianza.
facts.source_name: Oregon Judicial Department: Children and Family
facts.quote: In all counties, parents must take classes as part of child custody and parenting time cases.

facts.claim_en: Parents may be required to attend a parenting class and meet with a mediator to resolve disagreements.
facts.claim_es: Los padres pueden tener que asistir a una clase de crianza y reunirse con un mediador para resolver desacuerdos.
facts.source_name: Oregon Judicial Department: Mediation
facts.quote: The parents may be required to attend a parenting class for separating or divorcing parents and also meet with a mediator to try to resolve any disagreements.

facts.claim_en: Some Oregon counties require mediation before the court holds a custody or parenting time hearing.
facts.claim_es: Algunos condados de Oregón exigen mediación antes de que el tribunal celebre una audiencia de custodia o tiempo de crianza.
facts.source_name: Oregon Judicial Department: Mediation
facts.quote: In some counties, the court requires parents to attend mediation before the court will hold a hearing on custody or parenting time.

official_links.label_en: Oregon Judicial Department: Children and Family
official_links.label_es: Oregon Judicial Department: Children and Family

official_links.label_en: Oregon Judicial Department: Mediation
official_links.label_es: Oregon Judicial Department: Mediation

facts.claim_en: In Utah, legal custody is about who has the right to make important decisions about the children.
facts.claim_es: En Utah, la custodia legal se refiere a quién tiene derecho a tomar las decisiones importantes sobre los hijos.
facts.source_name: Utah State Courts Self-Help: Custody
facts.quote: Legal custody is about who has the right to make important decisions about the children.

facts.claim_en: Joint legal custody means both parents work together on major decisions.
facts.claim_es: La custodia legal compartida significa que ambos padres deciden juntos los temas importantes.
facts.source_name: Utah State Courts Self-Help: Custody
facts.quote: Joint legal custody means both parents work together to make decisions about major issues affecting the children.

facts.claim_en: Joint physical custody means the children live at least 111 nights a year with each parent.
facts.claim_es: La custodia física compartida significa que los hijos viven al menos 111 noches al año con cada padre.
facts.source_name: Utah State Courts Self-Help: Custody
facts.quote: Joint physical custody means the children live at least 111 nights a year in the home of each parent.

official_links.label_en: Utah State Courts Self-Help: Custody
official_links.label_es: Utah State Courts Self-Help: Custody

facts.claim_en: In Virginia, joint legal custody means both parents share responsibility and authority to make decisions about the child.
facts.claim_es: En Virginia, la custodia legal compartida significa que ambos padres comparten la responsabilidad y la autoridad para decidir sobre el hijo.
facts.source_name: Virginia Judicial System: Lynchburg JDR Court, Custody
facts.quote: Joint legal custody is when both parents retain joint responsibility for the care and control of the child and joint authority to make decisions concerning the child

facts.claim_en: Joint physical custody is where both parents share physical care of the child.
facts.claim_es: La custodia física compartida es cuando ambos padres comparten el cuidado físico del hijo.
facts.source_name: Virginia Judicial System: Lynchburg JDR Court, Custody
facts.quote: Joint physical custody is where both parents share physical and custodial care of the child.

facts.claim_en: Sole custody gives one parent primary responsibility for the child's care.
facts.claim_es: La custodia exclusiva da a un padre la responsabilidad principal del cuidado del hijo.
facts.source_name: Virginia Judicial System: Lynchburg JDR Court, Custody
facts.quote: Sole custody gives a parent the primary responsibility for the care of the child.

official_links.label_en: Virginia Judicial System: Lynchburg JDR Court, Custody
official_links.label_es: Virginia Judicial System: Lynchburg JDR Court, Custody

facts.claim_en: In Washington, a parenting plan is a legal document that explains the basic arrangements for the children.
facts.claim_es: En Washington, un plan de crianza es un documento legal que explica los arreglos básicos para los hijos.
facts.source_name: Washington Courts: Family Law Handbook
facts.quote: A parenting plan is a legal document that explains the basic arrangements for

facts.claim_en: Mediation on parenting plan issues is usually not appropriate if there has been a history of domestic violence.
facts.claim_es: La mediación sobre el plan de crianza generalmente no es apropiada si hay antecedentes de violencia doméstica.
facts.source_name: Washington Courts: Family Law Handbook
facts.quote: Mediation to resolve parenting plan issues is usually not appropriate if there has been a history of domestic violence.

facts.claim_en: The handbook covers what happens when a parent wants to move with the children under a parenting plan.
facts.claim_es: El manual explica qué pasa cuando un padre quiere mudarse con los hijos y hay un plan de crianza.
facts.source_name: Washington Courts: Family Law Handbook
facts.quote: If a parent wants to move with the children, and a parenting plan is in place, that

official_links.label_en: Washington Courts: Family Law Handbook
official_links.label_es: Washington Courts: Family Law Handbook

facts.claim_en: A West Virginia court may waive parent education for good cause, stating its reasons on the record.
facts.claim_es: Un tribunal de Virginia Occidental puede eximir la educación para padres por causa justificada, indicando sus razones.
facts.source_name: West Virginia Rules of Practice and Procedure for Family Court
facts.quote: For good cause shown, parent education may be waived if the court places on the record a finding attendance is not necessary

facts.claim_en: An order for an advanced child-focused parent education class sets the fee each party pays.
facts.claim_es: Una orden para una clase avanzada de educación para padres fija la tarifa que paga cada parte.
facts.source_name: West Virginia Rules of Practice and Procedure for Family Court
facts.quote: The order requiring parties to attend an advanced child-focused parent education class shall specify the fee each party shall pay

facts.claim_en: When paternity is determined, each parent is ordered to complete parent education by a set date.
facts.claim_es: Cuando se determina la paternidad, se ordena a cada padre completar la educación para padres antes de una fecha fija.
facts.source_name: West Virginia Rules of Practice and Procedure for Family Court
facts.quote: each parent or custodian shall be ordered to complete parent education by a date certain

official_links.label_en: West Virginia Rules of Practice and Procedure for Family Court
official_links.label_es: West Virginia Rules of Practice and Procedure for Family Court
